name: ListenBrainz
description: Submit listens and love/hate feedback to ListenBrainz, link a listener's account with a user token, and suggest music from ListenBrainz recommendations and generated playlists.

baseUrl.title: ListenBrainz API base URL
baseUrl.description: Base URL of the ListenBrainz API. Point it at a mirror or a test double to keep traffic off ListenBrainz.

labsBaseUrl.title: ListenBrainz labs base URL
labsBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the ListenBrainz labs API, which serves the similarity datasets. The datasets are served by a different host than the API; point this at a labs mirror or a test double to keep that traffic off ListenBrainz. Requests to it carry no user token.

token.title: User token
token.description: Your ListenBrainz user token, from https://listenbrainz.org/settings/.
